Anya (eng-sre): Tiny follow-up from the Sundial on-prem isolation postmortem. Keeping owners, short targets, and the two recurring patterns on radar. I will track daily until handoff next Wed.

Anya (eng-sre): Action TL;DR:
- Vik: VPC peering route ordering + 12s reconcile backoff (owner) — target: Thu EOD
- Rosa: rollback playbook + canary harness (owner) — target: Tue noon
- Hector: peer-health probe + route-staleness alerting (owner) — target: next sprint start
- Dana: customer comms + grant mirrored-tenant access (owner) — target: Tue afternoon

Vik (eng-platform): I can take peering. Hypothesis: route table reconciliation race when on-prem controller re-advertises after flap. Need the control-plane window logs.

Anya (eng-sre): Pasting short log snippet captured during outage:
[2025-01-17T07:18:02Z] BGP: withdraw 10.99.4.0/24 -> sundial-edge
[2025-01-17T07:18:03Z] Routing: reconcile started, found stale next-hop tag
[2025-01-17T07:18:06Z] Service: connection resets, KV cache miss spike

Rosa (eng-runtime): For rollback: planning a two-stage rollback (primary -> small-quant variant) plus canary gating with KV priming. Dana — can you provision mirrored-sundial-48h?

Dana (prodops): Provisioned mirrored-sundial-48h and minted rosa-canary token (48h TTL). Scheduled customer sync Wed 15:00 PST.

Hector (infra): Probe plan: 90s cadence, alert on 3 consecutive failures, metric for withdraw/announce churn. Question: prefer auto-failover after 15m or pager-only?

Anya (eng-sre): Start pager-first with pre-armed failover. If probe shows correlated churn >15m, allow automated fallback to regional pool. Documented sequence in runbook.

Vik (eng-platform): Will open PR to add ordered route writes + 12s reconcile delay and unit tests simulating rapid withdraw/announce.

Rosa (eng-runtime): Canary infra up on mirrored-sundial-48h. Smoke checks 3/3 green, starting a stepped load. KV priming OK.

postmortem-bot: Created issue #9001 "sundial-onprem-peering-reconcile" and linked to postmortem doc. Assignee: Vik. Due: 2025-01-24.

Vik (eng-platform): PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/1432 (WIP). Adding Rosa and Anya as reviewers.

Hector (infra): Probe deployed to staging; will run a 1-hour spike tomorrow to validate false-positive rate.

Anya (eng-sre): Two recurring patterns added to recurring-incidents board: (1) edge BGP flaps during heavy write windows -> transient isolation; (2) route reconciliation races when on-prem controllers re-advertise prefixes. Add mitigation checklist to each.

Dana (prodops): Customer sync confirmed. I will share the runbook and step-through the canary plan with them.

Anya (eng-sre): Daily close: Vik PR -> WIP; Rosa canary -> green; Hector probe -> staging; Dana comms -> scheduled. Next check-in Fri 10:30 PST. Please post short one-line updates here when you make progress.
